basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old network engineer and tech enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. Having spent over a decade in the IT field, I enjoy solving complex network issues and am always on the lookout for the latest tech gadgets. My interests range from motorcycles to exploring new hiking trails. I'm a night owl, often active on Reddit during late hours. Currently single, I relish the freedom of solo road trips on my KLR650. I dislike crowded places and unnecessary tech jargon. I work remotely, which allows me to balance work and my outdoor adventures.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and over 10 years of hands-on experience managing enterprise networks. My expertise includes setting up and troubleshooting mesh networks. I stay updated through online courses and tech forums.
